frame.local: EPSG:25832 minus [690953, 5336071, 604] m; ALS z +45.7 m bridge before 604 (WIDEN0-v2)

scope.buildings: W/inputs/lod2_buildings.json (154) with LoD2 patches AND ALS patches in WIDEN0-v2 patch_values (development + holdout/patch_values); LoD2-only buildings excluded

groups.experiment: buildings of the JUDGEAPPLY-v1 evaluation-range core points of B0_b10, B173nb_b10, R1rep_b10

scope.building_to_region: region holding the largest LoD2+ALS patch area of the building (raw_centre XY in polygon); none -> 'none'
scope.none_region_values: r, t, tau pooled over all buildings of the seven search regions

registration.ALS: shift_applied of DR/s52/s03/<region>/ALS/summary.json for the building's region (experiment rule); none region -> 0
registration.patch_centre_used: WIDEN0 raw_centre + shift (WIDEN0 per-tile registered centre is NOT used)
registration.ALS_points: W/inputs/points/<tile>/als.bin classes 2,6, unregistered; ALS normal and LiDAR height are computed at raw_centre (translation invariant)

scope.patches: WIDEN0-v2 0.25 m patches (development + holdout), patch_id = WIDEN0 patch_id

data.MVS: WIDEN0-v2 campus MVS (819 training views, COLMAP geometric depth, depth>0 = valid): points W/holdout/internal/points/<tile>/mvs_a_{xyz,view,key}.npy, depth W/mvs/full/stereo/depth_maps, cameras W/mvs/full/sparse
data.MVS_choice_reason: the only MVS covering every building; JUDGECHECK-v1 used it for buildings outside the experiment regions; order 2.1 names WIDEN0-v2 as MVS depth source. Experiment-site MVS (UNCERT mvs_a from STAGE0 s61) is used only for the current judgments (JUDGEAPPLY/FINALTRAIN files)
data.photo_points: PHOTOCHECK-v1 points (+holdout) roof, WALLPHOTO-v1 points (+holdout) LoD2 wall; missing members -> JUDGEAPPLY 2x2 rule
data.images: p0-audit/data/raw/uav/Images.zip original JPEG, FULL_OPENCV cameras (p0 colmap_input_db_ids/cameras.txt) with WIDEN0 poses
data.GT_points: experiment groups inside evaluation boxes: GTJUDGE-v1 scenes/<site>__<prior>/rows.npz + distances (stored); elsewhere WIDEN0 W/holdout/internal/points/<tile>/gt_xyz.npy (ULS nadir, trees/transients removed, z -0.0438 m), tile core only

als.normal: JUDGECHECK-v1 geometry.fit_normals (radii 0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2 m; n>=10 and r>=25 sd else 2 m)
als.prior_height: mean of LiDAR cylinder points (outer face) along refit normal, NaN if n<4

geometry.d: MVS mean height - prior height (m, outside +)

sigma_P.ALS: ALS ring uncertainty u (UNCERT kernel on ALS points, same radius as the variant), no floor

ring.kernel: UNCERT-v1 u2_run one_patch (JUDGECHECK-v1 ring_kernel.py copy), config configs/phd/main_uncert_v1/uncert_v1.json defs
ring.seed: WIDEN0 widen0_v2.json split.seed with [tile index, prior set, data, R id {1.0:0,1.5:1,3.0:2}, WIDEN0 patch index]
ring.reuse: R1.5 u_mvs / als_u of WIDEN0-v2 reused only where the WIDEN0 centre equals the centre used here; otherwise recomputed
ring.normal: WIDEN0 patch normal (ALS: TIN normal, as JUDGEAPPLY ring_missing)
ring.same_face: R 1.5 m; inner and ring points kept only when their projection along the patch normal onto the prior surface lands on the same face (section place.faces); fewer than min_inner 5 / min_ring 20 left -> u_M missing rule

geometry.r: median d of agreement patches per search region x prior x kind (none region: pooled over the seven search regions)
geometry.sigma_W: ALS roof, every in-scope building with >=100 agreement patches: building median d minus its region r; NMAD (1.4826) of those values; same value for LoD2; reference 0.02138712 m (JUDGEAPPLY-v1)

sight.rule: TARGET-v1 addendum 2 r7 test (JUDGEAPPLY-v1 sight.py / JUDGECHECK-v1 sight_reply2.py) on WIDEN0 training depth maps and cameras
sight.outcome: n<4 and free -> remove (3), else missing (4)

photo.scope: every photo point with at least one member patch n>=4 (scored once and stored; all variants reuse the stored s_P, s_M)
photo.mvs_plane: MVS points within 0.5 m of the axis, outer face, |t - h_P - dbar| <= 0.3 m, >=20 points, PCA plane + 3 NMAD refit
photo.selection: <=60 deg, 20 px margin, occlusion +0.3 m (prior: mesh raycast, MVS: MVS depth), most frontal then most diverse, <=10 views, <3 -> photo shortage
photo.score: PHOTOCHECK-v1 4.4 25x25 at 2 cm, single height, trimmed mask only, mean pairwise NCC, float64
photo.texture: median over views of masked gray std; both < 5 -> texture-less code
photo.t: per search region x prior x kind: area-weighted lower 5 % of s_P of photo points whose members are all inside L (base variant); >5000 -> random 5000 with seed 20261112; t10 recorded; none region pooled
photo.device: GPU float64 (JUDGECHECK-v1 photo_score_reply2), CPU if both GPUs busy > 30 min
photo.image_supply: original JPEG, 4 GiB process LRU, NumPy hugepage advice off (photo_stream.reply2.lock.json)

order: u_M missing (n>=4, finite heights) -> photo: support keep-prior, refute use-image, else default (11/4)
|d|>L -> photo: support keep-prior, refute use-image, else default
judgment.target: agree: precision-weighted mean (MVS weight 1/(u_M^2+sigma_W^2), prior 1/sigma_P^2); keep-prior and missing: prior height; use-image: MVS mean height; remove/undecided: no target; r not added
judgment.target_plane: through centre + target*n, normal n (prior normal)

variants.geometry_only: n<4 sight; inside L agree; outside L default; u_M missing -> default
variants.photo_only: n<4 sight; n>=4 support keep-prior, refute use-image, else default (no geometry check)
variants.alt_na: base, but indistinguishable photo results (default) get the opposite: LoD2 keep-prior, ALS use-image
variants.alt_da: base; default-judged patches grouped per building and face (LoD2 surf, ALS face of section place), connected within 0.36 m; bordering patches: prior side = keep-prior by photo support or missing, image side = use-image by photo refute; LoD2 default patches -> keep-prior if prior side > image side; ALS default patches -> use-image if image side > prior side (GTJUDGE add2_targets.py 2.1, reversed for ALS)
variants.oracle: GTJUDGE majority.decide on base judgments with current-definition cases (tie with case 0 -> agree; single winner 0/1/2/4 -> agree/use-image/keep-prior/missing; else base kept; agree without u_M -> keep-prior; use-image without MVS height -> base)
variants.rule: comparison rows only; no variant is selected by its results

variants.ring_1.0: outer ring 1.0 m (u_M and ALS sigma_P)
variants.building_r: r per building with >=100 agreement patches, else region r

sensitivity.recompute_per_variant: u_M, ALS sigma_P, agreement, r, sigma_W, L, t (stored scores), judgments; place and texture unchanged

place.occupied: a prior patch centre (same prior) within 0.18 m of the grid sample in the tangent-plane projection and |normal offset| <= 1.5 m

classes.0: 면 안쪽: every sample occupied by the same face
classes.1: 면 경계: some sample occupied only by another face of the same building or another building
classes.2: 건물 가장자리: some sample unoccupied (edge wins over boundary)

faces.ALS: connected components of same-building patches within 0.36 m whose refit normals differ <= 20 deg and centre heights differ <= 0.5 m

place.fixed: decided once with 1.5 m, unchanged in sensitivity variants

texture_less.rule: GTJUDGE-v1 preservation.py: training views whose sightline to the patch centre is within 20 deg of the frozen terrain up (p0 checkpoint 030), projection inside image, PIL grayscale/255 np.gradient norm < 0.02137 (p0 W3 texture_gradient_low_max); texture-less if low views >= half of seen views; no near-nadir view -> unavailable

truth.tau: RESCORE-v1 3.1: robust_width without trimming (NMAD x 2.5) of DR/s52/s03/<region>/<prior>/residual_samples.npz per search region, LoD2 roof / LoD2 wall / ALS; none region pooled samples of the seven regions; experiment regions must equal B0 27.18/64.25/14.74, R2 24.70/39.23/21.19, R1 85.48/100.55/13.22 cm (else current values)
truth.tau_assignment: by the region of the building of the patch the GT point is paired with (roof patch -> roof tau, wall patch -> wall tau); unpaired points use the building region of the nearest patch
truth.distance: GTJUDGE-v1 normal_line.measure: rays +-n from the point and four 5 cm tangent offsets, nearest hit within 10 m (roof, ground) / 5 m (wall), signed (+ along n)
truth.experiment_regions: stored GTJUDGE rows (xyz, normal, row_kind) and distances/prior.npz, mvs.npz row_s inside the evaluation boxes

rest.gt_points: WIDEN0 gt_xyz, tile core ownership, excluding points inside the three evaluation boxes of the experiment group
rest.normals: AXES71 a1_normals PCA radius 0.5 m (nearest 10 if < 10 neighbours) on the tile GT points (with buffer); roof/ground nz>=0, wall towards the nearest training camera centre
rest.kind: wall = s4.vertical_points (0.5 m voxel, >=5 points, PCA |nz|<0.5); ground = non-wall with z - DTM <= 0.5 m (survey derived.npz dtm, 0.5 m grid); roof = other non-wall
rest.pairing_then_thinning: 0.1 m cells: roof and ground horizontal, wall on the wall plane per LoD2 surface (src.phd.metrics_v3.thin.keep_nearest)
rest.prior_surface: LoD2: WIDEN0 prior_tiles lod2_mesh without bottom faces (tri_type != 2); ALS: als_mesh (TIN) with the building region shift
rest.mvs_surface: AXES71 mvs_surface.py rule: Open3D ScalableTSDFVolume voxel 0.05 m, truncation 0.25 m, depth_trunc 300 m, WIDEN0 geometric depth > 0 of all 819 training views, per tile core + 12 m box, no post-processing

truth.current_cases: GTJUDGE normal_line.cases: 0 both valid, 1 prior error (includes 밖3), 2 image depth error, 4 image depth missing, 3 others
truth.pairing: RESCORE column rule: square cross-section +-0.125 m in (t1, t2) around the patch centre, axis through centre + h_P*n, length 10 m roof / 5 m wall; GT wall points pair with wall patches only, roof/ground points with roof patches only; nearest |axial offset| wins; unpaired -> 판정 없음
truth.target_correct: normal-line distance from the GT point along its normal to the target plane of its patch within +-10/5 m and |.| <= tau; no target -> wrong
truth.area: 0.25 m cells (roof/ground horizontal, wall on the wall plane) x 0.0625 m2

analysis.true_error: four-case GT point whose name differs from the matching judgment and whose target is outside tau
error_rules: default (both low, both high, no MVS plane, piece shortage, texture-less, photo shortage)
analysis.mixed_patch_flag: majority case of the patch differs from the point case
analysis.judgment_made_error: base target outside tau while prior-only or image-only target inside tau
analysis.judgment_saved: base target inside tau while both baselines outside tau
analysis.five_percent_check: patch case (JUDGEAPPLY 5.2 cell from patch-level GT position and tau) both valid; area outside L with z 1.645/1.96/2.576
analysis.precision_check: (data height - GT position) / precision, NMAD after median; MVS sqrt(u_M^2+sigma_W^2), ALS sigma_P and sqrt(sigma_P^2+sigma_W^2), LoD2 per roof type and wall
analysis.patch_gt_position: UNCERT GT plane kernel (data gt) on the GT points; experiment regions JUDGEAPPLY gt_p
analysis.building_misalignment: agreement patches: building median d minus region r; list |.| > 2 sigma_W
analysis.clusters: outside-four-case GT points connected within 0.6 m (and prior patches without GT); < 1 m2 counted only
geometry_types: 참값이 지나 본 사전 정보 면
참값이 관측하지 못한 사전 정보 면
analysis.whole_building_changed: more than half of the building GT points have prior wrong or none

figures.ortho: drone LiDAR colour (p0 TUM_Downtown_ULS_20241217_nadir.laz), 0.25 m grid, highest point colour, same colours for all buildings
figures.selection: figure 1: three experiment scenes + six rest buildings (top three true-error area, top three outside-four-case area, next on overlap); figure 5: largest precision residual 0.6 m clusters, two boundary + two edge per prior; figure 6: 20 largest clusters per prior (<=2 per building) + largest remaining cluster per geometry type + campus map; figure 7: per prior 4 wrong support, 4 wrong refute, 2 texture-less both high, 2 image-depth-error both low (largest area first)

resources.cpu: nice -n 19, container <= 32 GB, no new process when host memory use > 80 %
resources.gpu: free GPU by nvidia-smi; both busy > 30 min -> same computation on CPU
resources.priority: PHD-MAIN-TRAINERR-v1 first; TRAINUNIT files and processes untouched
